visibleEditorialCopy.curiosityHook: Can two opportunistic hustlers keep their fragile partnership together long enough to cash in on a counterfeit fortune?
visibleEditorialCopy.description: In Buenos Aires, two grifters team up to pull off a lucrative swindle, attempting to sell forged rare stamps known as the "Nine Queens" to a wealthy collector.
visibleEditorialCopy.vibeSummary: Suspenseful and tightly wound, this sharp con-artist drama demands steady focus and pays off with mounting tension.
visibleEditorialCopy.whyWatch: Fabián Bielinsky's taut Argentine crime thriller pulls you into an intricate game of deception where every handshake and glance carries hidden stakes.
